title: The Way of Love

questions.question: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am a noisy gong or a ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:1 (ESV): "If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal."

questions.question: And if I have prophetic powers, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:2 (ESV): "And if I have prophetic powers, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing."

questions.question: If I give away all I have, and if I deliver up my body to be burned, but have not love, I ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:3 (ESV): "If I give away all I have, and if I deliver up my body to be burned, but have not love, I gain nothing."

questions.question: Love is patient and ____; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:4 (ESV): "Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant"

questions.question: Love does not insist on its own way; it is not ____ or resentful;
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:5 (ESV): "or rude. It does not insist on its own way; it is not irritable or resentful;"

questions.question: Love does not rejoice at wrongdoing, but rejoices with the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:6 (ESV): "it does not rejoice at wrongdoing, but rejoices with the truth."

questions.question: Love bears all things, believes all things, ____ all things, endures all things.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:7 (ESV): "Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things."

questions.question: Love never ends. As for prophecies, they will pass away; as for tongues, they will ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:8 (ESV): "Love never ends. As for prophecies, they will pass away; as for tongues, they will cease; as for knowledge, it will pass away."

questions.question: For we know in part and we prophesy in part, but when the perfect comes, the partial will ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:9-10 (ESV): "For we know in part and we prophesy in part, but when the perfect comes, the partial will pass away."

questions.question: When I was a child, I spoke like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I ____ the ways of childhood.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:11 (ESV): "When I was a child, I spoke like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I gave up childish ways."

questions.question: For now we see in a mirror dimly, but then ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:12 (ESV): "For now we see in a mirror dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I have been fully known."

questions.question: Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I have been fully ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:12 (ESV): "For now we see in a mirror dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I have been fully known."

questions.question: So now faith, hope, and love abide, these three; but the greatest of these is ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:13 (ESV): "So now faith, hope, and love abide, these three; but the greatest of these is love."

questions.question: What is the characteristic of love mentioned immediately after "love is patient and kind"?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:4 (ESV): "Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant"

questions.question: If someone has the gift of prophesy, understands all mysteries, has all knowledge, and faith to move mountains, but lacks love, Paul says they are:
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13:2 (ESV): "And if I have prophetic powers, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing."

key_verse_text: Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant or rude. It does not insist on its own way; it is not irritable or resentful; it does not rejoice at wrongdoing, but rejoices with the truth. Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
